# GrowLimo

> GrowLimo is a US-based digital marketing agency specializing in HIPAA-aware patient acquisition for healthcare practices and dental clinics, with full-service digital marketing for general businesses across California and Texas.

GrowLimo builds omnichannel marketing systems — SEO, Google Ads, Meta/Facebook Ads, PPC, social media, email marketing, and web design — for medical practices, dental offices, med spas, urgent care facilities, multi-location hospital groups, and regional businesses. Primary markets are California and Texas.

## Core

- [GrowLimo Home](https://growlimo.com/): Full-service digital marketing agency for US businesses — SEO, PPC, Google Ads, and lead acquisition.
- [About GrowLimo](https://growlimo.com/about/): Agency background, team, and mission — data-driven SEO, ROI-focused PPC, and web solutions for businesses nationwide.
- [Contact / Free Strategy Session](https://growlimo.com/contact/): Book a free 30-minute digital marketing strategy session with GrowLimo specialists.
